questions.passage: Cameron Highlands Trip. Last school holidays, my family and I went to Cameron Highlands. The journey took about three hours by car. When we arrived, the air was cool and fresh. We stayed at a small cottage near a tea plantation. The next morning, we visited the BOH Tea Centre where we learned how tea is processed. We also went to a strawberry farm and picked fresh strawberries. On the last day, we visited the Butterfly Garden. I was amazed by the variety of colourful butterflies. The trip was unforgettable and I hope to visit again.

So far, we have collected more than 200 kilograms of waste. The project has taught us the importance of taking care of the environment. I learned that fire safety is very important for everyone.
